findings.desc: packages/main/tests/red/red-fb7b-guard-bite.mjs:103-104 -- CHK-001:adversarial:2 evidence is a byte-identical duplicate of adversarial:4 (both call biteCase with the same {test:...}-only fixture and only assert the compiled structural smoke exits non-zero). The RED test red-fb7b-pretest-builds-utils.mjs is never invoked with the pretest key removed, so the intent claim RED test must FAIL at the first structural assertion is unproven by the recorded evidence -- it tests the smoke, not the RED, which is exactly what adversarial:4 already independently proves. Manually verified the underlying claim IS true (running red-fb7b-pretest-builds-utils.mjs with pretest deleted throws AssertionError at the first assert.ok), but the bound evidence command does not exercise that path at all.

packages/main/src/tasks/test-suite-utils-autobuild-smoke.ts:44-53 -- CHK-001:edge:2 intent explicitly requires a filesystem check ("confirm packages/main/dist/index.js ALSO exists"), but the bound evidence (the structural smoke) only does a regex string match on the pretest script text (buildsMain check) and never calls existsSync on packages/main/dist/index.js. Neither this smoke nor the RED test (which only checks packages/utils/dist/index.js) nor guard-bite ever verifies the main dist artifact exists on disk after npm run pretest. A pretest whose main-build sub-command silently fails or no-ops (while its literal script text still matches the --prefix packages/main run build regex) would pass this evidence unnoticed, so the edge case as literally specified is not covered.
